full_text_zh:
[P1] 亲爱的，WILLIAM WORRYOACTYL
不烦不烦
[英] 布莱恩·摩西◎著 [英] 迈克·龙登◎绘
王甜甜 吕海涛◎译
忧虑
北方联合出版传媒(集团)股份有限公司
万卷出版公司

[P2] 焦虑的小翼龙威廉住在一座高高的高塔上。
William Worrydactyl lived
in a very tall tower.

[P3] 每当他爸爸妈妈要出门的时候，
他们都会从窗户飞出去。
His Mum and Dad
would fly out of the
window when they
left home.
可是，威廉忧心忡忡，
根本不敢从窗户飞出去。
他担心自己不会飞，
或者无法安全着陆。
But William was too
worried to fly out
of the window. He
worried that he wouldn't
be able to fly, or land.

[P4] 每次爸爸妈妈带他出门，
他们全都坐电梯下楼。
When his parents
took him out, they
all went down in
the lift.
然而，即便是坐电梯，威廉也依旧焦虑不安。
But William worried about being in a lift.
他担心电梯关门时夹住他的翅膀。
He worried about getting his wings
trapped in the door when it closed.

[P5] 威廉担心夜晚天黑了以后
第二天早晨天不会亮。
William worried that
when it got dark at night, it wouldn't
get light again the next day.

[P6] 威廉担心自己的翅膀
不如朋友们的强壮。
William worried that his
wings weren't as strong
as his friends' wings.
他还担心自己跳不了
朋友那么高。
He worried that he
couldn't jump as high
as they could.

[P7] 就连飞去恐龙学校都让他忧虑不已。
He worried about going to flying dino-school.
威廉似乎无法像其他
恐龙那样学会飞行。
William didn't seem
able to learn to fly like
the other dinosaurs.

[P8] “每个人都会有那么一点焦虑，”他妈妈说。
"Everyone worries a bit," his Mum said.

“可是你，威廉，你的焦虑就像是一条
蠕动着的小虫子，始终在你的脑袋里爬啊爬。”
“But you, William, your worries are like wriggly
worms slithering around in your head.”

[P9] 威廉的妈妈做了一个焦虑盒。“你可以把自己
担忧的事情写在小纸片上，然后把小纸片
放到这个盒子里，”她说。
William's Mum made a Worry Box. “You can
write down your worries on little pieces of paper
and put them into this box,” she said.
“每天晚上临睡前，我们都会从盒子里抽出
一张小纸片，然后我和你一起谈谈写在
那上面的让你感到焦虑的事情。”
“Then we'll take out a different worry each
night and talk about it before you go to sleep.”

[P10] 就这样，威廉按照妈妈说的做了。
他把自己的焦虑写下来：
大的焦虑，还有小的焦虑。
So that's what William did. He wrote down his worries; his big worries and his little worries.

[P11] 每天晚上，妈妈都会和威廉谈论
这些让他焦虑不堪的事情。
And every night they
talked about them.
每次谈话之后，
威廉都会
觉得那些大大的焦虑
似乎变小了许多。
And every time
they talked about
one of William's BIG
worries, it seemed to
shrink in size.
而那些小的焦虑在和妈妈谈过之后似乎就彻底消失了。
And every time they talked about one of
William's little worries, it seemed to disappear.

[P12] 直到有一天，威廉说，“现在，如果我还想
看看我的焦虑，我想我大概需要一个放大镜。”
Until one day William said, “If I want to see my
worries now, I think I’ll need a magnifying glass.”
“我想，我尝试第一次飞行的时机应该到了。”
“I think the time has come for
me to try my first flight.”

[P13] 当威廉站在窗户前，准备起飞的时候，
他妈妈警告他说，“小心一点哦。”
As William stood at the window ready
to take off, his Mum warned him, “Be careful.”
他爸爸则大声说道，
“只飞一小段距离就可以了。”
While his Dad called out,
“Only a short one.”

[P14] “别为我担心了，”
威廉回答说，
“我会没事的。”
“Don't worry about me,”
William called back,
“I'll be all right.”
说完，他就……
And he was...
full_text_en:
[P1] Dear, WILLIAM WORRYOACTYL
Not Troubled, Not Annoyed
[UK] Brian Moses ◎ Author [UK] Mike Lowery ◎ Illustrator
Wang Tiantian, Lü Haitao ◎ Translators
Worry
Northern United Publishing Media (Group) Co., Ltd.
Wanjuan Publishing Company

[P2] The anxious little pterosaur William lived in a very tall tower.
William Worrydactyl lived
in a very tall tower.

[P3] Whenever his mum and dad were going out,
they would fly out of the window.
His Mum and Dad
would fly out of the
window when they
left home.
But William was too worried to fly out of the window.
He worried that he wouldn't be able to fly, or land.

[P4] Every time his parents took him out,
they all went down in the lift.
When his parents
took him out, they
all went down in
the lift.
However, even in the lift, William was still anxious.
But William worried about being in a lift.
He worried about his wings getting trapped in the door when it closed.
He worried about getting his wings
trapped in the door when it closed.

[P5] William worried that
when it got dark at night, it wouldn't
get light again the next day.

[P6] William worried that his wings weren't as strong as his friends' wings.
He worried that he couldn't jump as high as they could.

[P7] Even flying to dinosaur school made him worry.
He worried about going to flying dino-school.
William didn't seem
able to learn to fly like
the other dinosaurs.

[P8] "Everyone worries a bit," his Mum said.

"But you, William, your worries are like wriggly worms slithering around in your head."

[P9] William's Mum made a Worry Box. "You can write down your worries on little pieces of paper and put them into this box," she said.
"Then we'll take out a different worry each night and talk about it before you go to sleep."

[P10] So that's what William did. He wrote down his worries; his big worries and his little worries.

[P11] Every night, Mom would talk with William
about the things that made him anxious.
And every night they
talked about them.
After each conversation,
William would
feel as if his big worries
had shrunk a lot.
And every time
they talked about
one of William's BIG
worries, it seemed to
shrink in size.
And every time they talked about one of
William's little worries, it seemed to disappear.

[P12] Until one day William said, “If I want to see my worries now, I think I’ll need a magnifying glass.”
“I think the time has come for me to try my first flight.”

[P13] As William stood at the window ready to take off, his Mum warned him, “Be careful.”
While his Dad called out, “Only a short one.”

[P14] "Don't worry about me," William called back, "I'll be all right."

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《亲爱的，不烦不烦》的封面，展示了书名、作者、绘者、译者及出版社信息。画面中，一只紫色的翼龙角色（威廉）正从岩石上跳下，腰间系着写有“忧虑”的绿色带子，旁边有一只粉色的小翼龙和一只绿色的小恐龙在沙地上。
[P2] 本页介绍了主角威廉，一只焦虑的小翼龙，他住在一座高高的塔里，画面展示了塔的外观和周围的风景。
[P3] 本页描绘了威廉的父母从高塔的窗户飞出去，而威廉却因担心自己不会飞或无法安全着陆而不敢出门，表现出他的焦虑情绪。
[P4] 威廉和父母一起乘坐电梯下楼，但他依然焦虑不安，担心电梯门会夹住他的翅膀。
[P5] 威廉站在高塔顶端，望着星空，担心夜晚过后天不会再亮，表现出他对未知的持续焦虑。
[P6] 威廉站在悬崖边，看着朋友们在空中飞翔和跳跃，他担心自己的翅膀不够强壮，也担心自己跳得没有朋友高。
[P7] 威廉在恐龙飞行学校里表现出极大的焦虑，他无法像其他恐龙那样学会飞行，而其他恐龙则在空中自由飞翔或在地面练习。
[P8] 威廉的妈妈安慰他，每个人都会有一点焦虑，但威廉的焦虑特别严重，就像脑子里有小虫子在爬动。
[P9] 威廉的妈妈为他制作了一个焦虑盒，让他把担忧写在纸条上放进盒子里，并承诺每晚睡前一起讨论其中一条担忧，以帮助他应对焦虑情绪。
[P10] 威廉按照妈妈的建议，开始把自己的焦虑写下来，包括大的和小的担忧，画面展示了他记录焦虑时的几个情景。
[P11] 威廉和妈妈每晚讨论他的焦虑，大焦虑变小，小焦虑消失，画面展示了他们交谈的温馨场景。
[P12] 威廉意识到自己的焦虑已经减轻，他决定尝试第一次飞行。
[P13] 威廉准备第一次飞行，他的妈妈提醒他小心，爸爸则建议他只飞一小段距离。
[P14] 威廉从悬崖上起飞，向父母保证自己会没事，随后成功飞向天空。
